_comment: Tunable market knowledge that no source publishes. Edit and the next collection picks it up.

cityOffsets._comment: Libyan sites publish one market rate, almost always the Tripoli (Mushir) quote. Dealers in other cities trade a little off it. When a source names a city directly that real number always wins; these offsets only fill a city no source quoted, and such values are labelled as estimates, never as readings.

offsetNote: فرق سوق مصراتة مرصود ميدانياً: السعر المنشور عادةً أعلى بقرشين إلى ثلاثة.
